images.subject: A high-tech nanite factory built around one colossal glass containment cylinder that rises almost to the top of the cliff. In the left half of the frame, on the open ground, a second large and clearly separate block: a wide low glass-roofed nanite processing hall glowing silver from inside. On the right side of the frame, carved into the dark cliff face to the right of the main cylinder, a third large and clearly separate block: a tall chamber cut into the rock behind a huge glass window, filled with a glowing cloud of silver nanoparticles.
images.detail: A swirling cloud of silver nanoparticles glows inside the cylinder.
